answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to held assets rather than node count. Like a stable basalt foundation supporting a vast digital lagoon, this capital requirement forces attackers to incur massive opportunity costs. An adversary attempting to inflate identity counts would be as fragile as a willow branch under the weight of staked equity, as the expenditure required to acquire meaningful voting power makes decentralized subversion prohibitively expensive.
